newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama rejects French firm's racetrack bid.
newsitem.headline: Panama rejects French firm's racetrack bid.

text.p: Panama threw out pre- qualification documents for France's state betting group Pari Mutuel Urbain (PMU) to operate the nation's only race track saying their papers were not in order, Treasury Minister Miguel Heras said Thursday.
Heras told reporters the company's documents were not properly signed by company officials.
Heras said Puerto Rico's Equus Gaming Co was left as the only company qualified to participate, and that Panama will begin direct negotiations with Equus to see whether they can reach an agreement.
Panama had reopened the pre-qualification process last year to generate more participation.
Panama's Constitution prohibits the sale of the race track, but foreign companies can operate it.
